raw_segments.text: Corny Kelleher closed his long day book and glanced with his drooping eye at a pine coffin
He pulled himself erect, went to it, and spinning it on its axle, viewed its shape and brass
Chewing his blade of hay, he laid the coffin lid by and came to the doorway.
There he tilted his hat brim to give shade to his eyes and leaned against the door case,
